## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An 18-juan classical-philosophical *biji* by Zhōu Qí of Mǎpíng (Guǎngxī), in 13 thematic categories: *Xìng dào tán* 性道談 (2 juan), *Lǐ qì tán* 理氣談 (1), *Jì sì tán* 祭祀談 (2), *Xué shù tán* 學術談 (1), *Chū chǔ tán* 出處談 (1), *Wù lǐ tán* 物理談 (1), *Jīng zhuàn tán* 經傳談 (3), *Zhù shù tán* 著述談 (1), *Shǐ xì tán* 史系談 (2), *Rú zhèng tán* 儒正談 (1), *Wén cí tán* 文詞談 (1), *Yì duān tán* 異端談 (1), *Pì yì tán* 闢異談 (1). The work derives doctrinally from the *Hé-Dōng xuépài* of Xuē Xuān ([KR3a0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3a/KR3a0079) author). The *Guǎngxī tōng zhì* records a separate *Rú zhèng piān* discussing Xuē Hédōng's learning; the SKQS *tíyào* identifies this as juan 15 of the present work — not a separate composition. First printed in *Jiājìng dīngyǒu* (1537) by Lǚ Jǐngméng 呂景蒙; the SKQS-base appears to be a manuscript transcription, the original woodblocks having been lost.

**Abstract**

The *Dōngxī rì tán lù* is a useful Mid-Míng *Lǐxué*-orthodox *biji* in the *Hé-Dōng xuépài* line of Xuē Xuān. Composition window: bracketed by Zhōu Qí's working life from his 1481 *jìnshì*; the work was published posthumously in 1537. The frontmatter brackets to 1481–1537.

The substantive content — 13 thematic categories spanning metaphysics, ritual, learning, ethics, classics, history, and heterodoxy — is methodologically conventional Mid-Míng *Lǐxué* but provides a useful prosopographical window into the *Hé-Dōng* tradition's reach into the Guǎngxī periphery. The juan on Xuē Xuān (j. 15, *Rú zhèng tán*) is the principal substantive contribution: a Mid-Míng student's evaluation of his master.

The bibliographic record: *Míng shǐ yìwén zhì*; *Wényuāngé shūmù*; *Guǎngxī tōng zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Rújiā lèi*.
